response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_cost, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating), o AS (SELECT AVG(per_day) AS overall FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.avg_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(r.per_day) AS avg_per_day_rate, AVG(r.per_day - o.overall) AS avg_excess_over_cross_rating_average FROM r CROSS JOIN o WHERE r.per_day > o.overall
